evidence.source: Breakout Protocol research, 8-9 Nov 2026 (handoff research digest)

items.title: Idea first: greenlight only with outlier evidence
items.summary: A premise is greenlit only with outlier evidence - a comparable video at 5 times its channel's median or more - plus a saturation check. The idea decides most of the result before a word is written.

items.title: Packaging before script, with a promise contract
items.summary: Titles and thumbnails are made before the script (many titles times several thumbnails, judged at phone size 168x94) and form a promise contract: the video must show what the package promised, on screen, early.

items.title: Hook gate: absurd image, stakes, a prediction, no preamble
items.summary: The opening shows an absurd image in frame 1, sets the stakes by 0:05, asks the viewer to predict, and has no preamble. A question or a 'you' stake lands within 3 seconds (1.5 seconds on Shorts).

items.title: Retention: but / therefore, re-hooks, loops that close
items.summary: Beats are linked with 'but' and 'therefore', never 'and then'. A re-hook comes at least every 75 seconds (re-hooks near 25% and 50%), and every opened loop closes before 85% of the runtime.

items.title: No upload below Breakout Score 80
items.summary: No video is uploaded below Breakout Score 80. A score of 88 or more is breakout-grade and earns an extra Short and a community post. When a video is held, the weakest component is named.

items.title: Hard gates: promise, facts, repetition, policy
items.summary: A video is held when its promise is unmet, a fact is unsupported, it repeats earlier work, or it carries a policy risk. Rework runs at most 2 loops per stage, then the piece is shelved.

items.title: 48-hour breakout monitor answers with follow-ups
items.summary: 48 hours after publishing, a breakout is detected against the channel's own baseline and answered at once: 2 follow-up Shorts and a sequel premise placed at the top of the bench.

items.title: Case Files compilations: new material, loops, varied verdicts
items.summary: Case Files compilations run 25-40 minutes with at least 35% new material, loops between cases and varied verdicts. Dr. Grimm fails in at most 40% of the cases, because YouTube treats 'same situation, same outcome' as repetitive content.

evidence.source: Spin-off and sound research, 9 Nov 2026 (handoff research digest)

items.title: One Deep Trial special a month
items.summary: One long slot a month is a Deep Trial: a longer, deeper case built for watch hours and for breakout, with the same quality gates as any long video.

evidence.source: Spin-off and sound research, 9 Nov 2026 (handoff research digest)

items.title: Standalone audio re-trials were dropped
items.summary: Standalone audio-only re-trials were dropped as a format. A sleep edition may run only as ONE gated test, never as a standing series.

evidence.source: Spin-off and sound research, 9 Nov 2026 (handoff research digest)

items.title: What breakout channels share
items.summary: Breakout channels share five things: a stand-in for the viewer, a question that is withheld, a high-arousal emotion (awe or dread), recurring characters with lore, and an authored look nobody else has.

items.title: Nostalgia: strong for sends, weak as a brand
items.summary: Nostalgia drives connectedness and sends (Sedikides and Wildschut) but monetises poorly as a whole brand. Use it only as seasoning inside tests, for example a sensory first-person cold open as an experiment arm.

items.title: Watch hours come from long videos; Shorts are discovery
items.summary: Watch hours come from long videos and spin-offs; Shorts are discovery that funnels viewers to long videos. Honest odds: 4,000 hours by 1 Feb 2027 needs a breakout; the base case is 8,000 hours in months 8-12. Checkpoint: 11 Jan 2027.

evidence.source: Growth and money research, 9 Nov 2026 (handoff research digest; requirements ledger section D)

items.title: Keep the science framing: it pays about 8 times more
items.summary: The Education & Science RPM median is about $10 against about $1.2 for Health: keep the science framing in titles, descriptions and category. Facebook Reels RPM is tiny, so Facebook is reach only.

evidence.source: Growth and money research, 9 Nov 2026 (handoff research digest)

items.title: Instagram ranks by sends
items.summary: Instagram's strongest ranking signal is sends: every Reel needs one moment a viewer would send to a friend.
